exposure: Type of CNS anomaly (HCP, DWM, MMC)
Prenatal diagnosis of CNS anomalies (HCP, DWM, MMC)
Prenatal diagnosis of one of three CNS anomalies
cohort: Pregnancies complicated by fetal CNS anomalies (HCP, DWM, MMC) in Alberta, Canada between 2001 and 2011
finding: This study provides termination rates, obstetric interventions, and NICU length of stay for prenatally-identified CNS anomalies.
mod_finding: Rate of Caesarean section for fetal indication was 50.0%, 44.4%, and 42.9% for HCP, DWM, and MMC, respectively.
gest_age: Median GA at diagnosis were 22 weeks (range 17-38), 20 weeks (range 12-37), and 20.5 weeks (range 18-34) for HCP, DWM, and MMC, respectively.
